approach: Static recompilation of the Unreal Engine 3 program and its DLLs to C with our own translator; a new Windows stand-in on SDL3; Direct3D 9 to Vulkan through DXVK.
notes: Generally untested: only the menus and the first level have been played, with a controller, on one computer. No downloads; build it from your own GOG copy. Adds the Xbox 360 version's controls (layouts, Control Config screen, button pictures and prompts, rumble), every screen resolution, and bars instead of stretching.
help: Playing further than the first level
